items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Who used to play with him during that time? Like Sean and John McCullough.

ctx.x: Who used to play with him, huh?
Who used to play with him during that time? Like Sean and John McCullough.
Sean McCullough. Sean McCullough. Who used to do? And a little bit of, I don't even know how old he was or just when did he die. I never didn't hear him or meet him of course, so. I'm saying.
